text: My manager asked for this. Morph all the hexagons that are not purple into a star, then nuke the orange triangles. Connect Milk to Mix and Mix to Eggs.
Sorry, long day. Rename the Begin into Onyx. What's the highest one? Can you describe the canvas?
Wire Salt to Bowl. Because the old one was wrong. Spawn a pair of indigo ovals. What's the nearest shape to Yeast? And what's written on Mix?
Remove everything! Any scarlet ovals? Hook Earth to Atom and Pluto, and then link Orbit to Saturn and Mars.

My manager asked for this. Fill the balls with blue. I keep losing track of things. Set the colour of the circles to fuchsia, then shrink them, and align them horizontally. Sorry, long day. Bring Running to front.
Swap Button1 and Menu. Then recolour all the gray ones silver. Thanks!
Shift the lilac star on the top, then send the same one to the back.
Reposition Doing below Todo. Then make a copy of the last diamond. Make 2 copies of the green dot. Also change the teal ones to a tiny diamond. Next, redo the last change.
Unhook Booting from Waiting. Show the stars, please?

I'm explaining this to my team later. Take that back. Next, turn the fuchsia ones minuscule. Make Safety, Te and Tackle larger. Almost done. Insert a star called Spire between Safety and Striker. Thanks!
Re-apply that. Then make the pink stars an amber triangle!
Hmm, let me think. Led between Vcc and C2. Is it pink? And what is attached to Coil?
What is the size of Banner? From now on all shapes are average. Exchange Avatar with Menu.
Recolour Support indigo. I keep losing track of things. Nudge it 150 px to the right.
Set the shape of the gold ones to rhombus. Sorry, long day. What is the shape of Olivia? Push the same one downwards. Almost done.
Is the black box at the top? Change Deployed, Ticket9 and Story to regular!
Hmm, let me think. Is there a triangle below Search? Set the colour of the orange stars to orange.
Dupe the latest triangle 6 times and erase all the shapes. Connect Story to Doing and Doing to Bug42.
What is nearest to Sink? Turn all the circles that are not magenta into a massive green triangle! Is the Source bigger than the most recent triangle?
Let me see. Space all the shapes in a row. Move them between Batter and Flour. Take that back.
Axe the stars that are not indigo. Swap Gateway with Uplink, please!
Is Intern reachable from Hr? Reset the diagram!
Stick an indigo triangle between Testing and Doing. Next, make the indigo triangle a bit smaller.
Nudge the first diamond between Stop2 and Reject, then re-apply.
Let me see. Inscribe "end" on the gold star, and after that drag it to the right of Plankton. Then change the shape of all shapes to a square. Nice.
Banish golden hexagons! Ugh, messy. Is Source linked to Monitor?
Ok, so I'm sketching our office network. Link Export to the earliest rhombus, then shrink Clean. It was getting crowded. Duplicate it 3 times!
Give all the squares that are not cyan a navy color, and after that reapply.
Hmm, let me think. Turn all the green ones grey. Next, trash Finance!
Raise the most recent grey star, and then rename the same one to Quill. List all indigo ovals? Reposition Parse between Source and Enrich.
Clear triangles. After that, remove all the squares that are not blue. Build a magenta hexagon and name it Beacon. Next, lay out as a ring.

I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. What shapes are aqua? Rename the most recent diamond to Spire. Okay, that's better. Connect Verify and Decide. We need it for the meeting. How many neighbors has the new rose square got? Insert a gray triangle with the name Thistle!

My manager asked for this. Olivia is a square. Make Grandma double the size. After that, organise all of the rects in a circle! By default, triangles should be big! Scoot the newest rhombus to the right of Sophia.
In the future, make rectangles black! Reapply.
Disconnect Goals from Idea. Is Pricing linked to Goals?
Enlarge each hexagon, then arrange them as a grid.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Is Truck connected to Port? Add a dash wire from Customs to Factory!
Pod1 is between Queue and S3! Clone this one 3 times.
Throw a pink diamond "x > 0" in the lower left. Then push the newest one 60 px to the left, and make a copy of the gray oval. Is there a path from Ending to Prologue?
How many connections does Sprint1 have? Spawn an enormous oval. Almost done. Bug42 is left side of Epic! Ticket9 is a lime box.
Uncle and the cyan ellipse switch places. I keep losing track of things. Slide all the lilac boxes to the middle. Reset all the shapes. What shapes are indigo?
Scoot Store to the left. Is that one green? Rename this one to Grove. Okay, that's better. Spread each hexagon out vertical.
Henceforth new shapes should be black. Describe the canvas?
Label the last circle "payment", and wipe all ellipses that are not yellow. It should read better now. Send the oval behind. Nice.
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Change the ovals that are not blue to regular, then reposition the rose hexagons to the left 200 pixels. Then tag the block "start"!
Banish Qb, Corner2 and Striker, then rename Striker to Lark. Does Tackle link to the triangle?
Space the squares out evenly on a vertical line. Also, arrange them vertically.
Remove brown hexagons. Almost done. Align Decide, Start and Approve.
Which node has the fewest arrows? Convert the balls into a triangle. Next, align them vertically!
Turn all shapes into a massive indigo dot. What's nearest to Studio?
Let me see. Henceforth ovals are tiny and scarlet. Reshape the purple triangles into an oval!
Ditch pink rects, then organize as a column.
Snip the line between Heron and Seal! Ugh, messy. Which node is the topmost? Crab is medium!
Hmm, let me think. Swap Milk with Flour, and then erase the whole diagram.
Is there a route from Liam to Aunt? Wire Bob to Grandpa and Liam. Next, align the brown dots on a vertical line!
Turn all shapes little. Put a lilac diamond that says "Is it valid?" between Alice and Sophia, and rename the diamond to Nectar.
Where is the Earth? Trade Orbit and Venus. What shape is the magenta hexagon?

Connect Bucket, Pod2, Billing and Pod1 in a chain with a yellow undirected arrow. Almost done. How many brown hexagons in the bottom left? Park the red stars upwards by 25 points. Also, tie Pod2 and Api! Thanks.
Ditch turquoise stars, and bring Train to the front. Then make the same one blue.
Set the colour of all shapes to scarlet, then reapply that!
Put Mix, Salt and Batter left of the square and erase the link between Eggs and Dough! Summarise the drawing?
Pod1 and S3 switch places, then relocate Billing, S3 and Lambda in the bottom right.
Ok, so I'm sketching our office network. Place Error, Paused and Stopped between Armed and Loading. Also, turn all shapes black. Sorry, long day. Recolor the new square green.
Turn all triangles which are not indigo into a rose star. Kill the edge from Mercury to Comet. Then connect Pluto and Jupiter to Moon. After that, turn Mars into an orange star.
What can I get to from Sprint1? Move the orange ball up. I keep losing track of things. Wipe all the stars that are not green.
Let me see. Tie Icing to Butter, Butter to Sugar! Are any stars between Dough and Sugar? Clone Eggs. Is Icing not magenta? Bring the brown dot in front.
Snip Store from Plant. Almost done. Colour Courier, Retailer and Factory brown. What are the neighbors of the square?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Slap a navy dot saying "checkout" between Sprint2 and Deployed. Then put the navy circle under Testing. Also, color it rose. Then spawn an ellipse.
What shapes are white? Is the newest black ball little? Hook this one to Fish. After that, duplicate the last aqua hexagon twice. Make each dot a giant lime dot!
Align Swamp, Dungeon and Castle horizontally. Place eight purple squares.
Layout all blocks in a ring! New rects should be amber! Remove the aqua diamonds.
Rename Intro as Mango. Also, throw a brown star on the left. Is it white? Are there any ovals that are not indigo?
Move all the lime squares up 150 points! Are there triangles in the bottom-left corner?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Convert the triangles that are not gold into a hexagon. Turn Vpn and Uplink tiny, and make Switch1 an ellipse. Slide Vpn on top of Firewall.
Turn the navy ovals enormous. That's the main flow. How many lines does Metrics have?

This is for tomorrow's review. Shift Decide and Start at the top. Are Finish and the white rhombus linked? Zap Finish, Verify and Check. We need it for the meeting. Turn Done and Check into a blue ball.
Slap a square, and after that rename the square to Aster. Are there loops?
Link Chapter4 and Intro to Villain, then rename Villain Grove. Is the blue star at the bottom?
Scoot the black diamonds to the left of Vpn. We need it for the meeting. Make the oldest navy oval a rhombus.
Color Rb, Wr2 and Wr1 magenta, and after that axe the fuchsia oval. Connect Qb to Tackle. Then send the first rhombus behind.
Ok, so I'm sketching our office network. Make a ball called Tango to the lower left corner, and shift Stop2 between Finish and Start! Is it golden? Copy it 3 times.
Is the latest box not teal? Shift that one 150 px to the left. Is Oven between Salt and Icing? Push it 10 px to the left!
Make all of the white ellipses twice as large! What text is on Sun?
Place a violet rhombus called Juno with the text "Save" between Task7 and Sprint1, and after that make the rhombus a bit smaller. How small is Epic?
Ditch all the rects that are not black! Which shapes are green? Add 7 gray hexagons on the right of Reject. Nice.
New hexagons must be tiny. Is there a hexagon beside Monitor? Trade Archive and Validate.
Hook Epic up to Blocked. After that, link Testing and Sprint1 to Blocked.
How many arrows does the blue box have? Redo that!
How many lines does the white hexagon have? Slap a hexagon at the right. Then paint the last one magenta.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Draw ten small squares at the right, then align them in a row. Join Header and Button1 to Card with a cyan arrow, then grow the first oval a bit.
Cave connects to Volcano! Make a copy of the circle, then make all the brown ones lime. It should read better now. How many connections are there?
I'm explaining this to my team later. Does the most recent dot reach the first silver rhombus? Can Nucleus reach Neptune? Take it back.
Erase the whole diagram. Are Open2 and Closed connected?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Lay out the things as a row. Just tidying things up a bit. Draw another star to the middle. Is there a connection between Verify and the red square?
Swap the positions of Lounge and Hallway! From now on squares should be amber!
We are planning the next sprint. Summarize the diagram? Rename the indigo rhombus Lark!
Connect Billing, Cache and Kafka every pair. Cache is between Pod1 and Redis. Insert a square called Cinder right of Cache.
Count the links? Tell me about the teal square? How many connections does Pantry have? Do the arrows form a loop?
Show me the rules? Push the square below Hallway, and then shift the same one right!

Tie Neptune, Sun and Pluto each to the next. It should read better now. List the connections of the Orbit? Make a minuscule turquoise diamond and name it Nook. Attach Nucleus and Saturn to Earth. It should read better now. Is the star not gray?
